tool.name: TreeAnalysis
tool.summary: Tree crown detection and analysis pipeline. Extracts tree-class pixels, smooths polygon boundaries with PAEK, optionally separates merged canopies (Watershed or Grid — mutually exclusive), computes geometry and zonal statistics, and classifies features by area and nDSM height thresholds.
tool.usage: 1. Provide the classified raster and select the Tree class value. 2. Provide the nDSM raster (height above ground in meters). 3. Optionally provide a thermal raster for temperature enrichment. 4. Choose Crown Separation Method: - None (default): no crown separation. - Watershed: nDSM-based ITCD for polygons above Min Area threshold. Only polygons with 3+ detected peaks are split. - Grid: fishnet overlay for simple deterministic splitting. 5. Set classification thresholds for area and nDSM height. 6. Output: tree_results.shp, tree_points.shp, tree_log.json.

param.name: in_classified
param.dialogReference: Single-band integer raster from the DeepLabV3 model.

param.name: tree_class
param.dialogReference: Integer value representing the Tree class.

param.name: in_ndsm
param.dialogReference: Normalised Digital Surface Model (height above ground, meters).

param.name: in_thermal
param.dialogReference: Surface temperature raster in degrees Celsius.

param.name: in_aoi
param.dialogReference: Optional clip boundary for analysis area.

param.name: out_crs
param.dialogReference: CRS for output shapefiles. Defaults to classified raster CRS.

param.name: cell_size_option
param.dialogReference: Cell size for raster processing.

param.name: cell_size_custom
param.dialogReference: Custom cell size, used when "Custom" is selected.

param.name: min_area
param.dialogReference: Polygons smaller than this are rejected. Default: 2.0 m².

param.name: max_area
param.dialogReference: Polygons larger than this are rejected. Default: 260 m².

param.name: min_ndsm
param.dialogReference: Minimum mean nDSM to classify as tree. Default: 1.0 m.

param.name: reject_null_ndsm
param.dialogReference: If checked, features with no nDSM coverage are rejected.

param.name: majority_neighborhood
param.dialogReference: FOUR, EIGHT, or Skip.

param.name: majority_passes
param.dialogReference: Number of MajorityFilter passes (1-5).

param.name: smooth_tol
param.dialogReference: PAEK smoothing tolerance. Default: 0.30 m.

param.name: crown_method
param.dialogReference: None: no crown separation (default). Watershed: nDSM-based Individual Tree Crown Delineation. Applied ONLY to polygons larger than "Min Area for Watershed". Uses local maxima detection with prominence filtering. Polygons with fewer than 3 detected peaks remain intact. Grid: simple fishnet overlay for deterministic splitting. Watershed and Grid are mutually exclusive.

param.name: ws_min_area
param.dialogReference: Only polygons larger than this area are processed by watershed. Smaller polygons are kept untouched. Default: 120 m². Enabled only when Crown Separation = Watershed.

param.name: ws_search_radius
param.dialogReference: Radius in meters for local maxima (tree-top) detection. Larger values find fewer, more distinct peaks. Default: 6.0 m. Typical range: 3-10 m depending on tree size. Enabled only when Crown Separation = Watershed.

param.name: grid_size
param.dialogReference: Fishnet cell size in meters. Should approximate expected single-tree crown diameter. Default: 5.0 m. Enabled only when Crown Separation = Grid.

param.name: do_centroids
param.dialogReference: Generate centroid point shapefile for tree inventory.

param.name: out_folder
param.dialogReference: Root output folder. A "trees" subfolder is created.
